requirements.description: Alphabet FY2025 10-K: original tables, introductions and footnotes disclosing 2025 share repurchase amount (Note 11 annual table incl. footnote on unsettled repurchases), Item 5 Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities table with footnotes (average price includes costs associated with repurchases), and remaining repurchase authorization ($69.5 billion as of December 31, 2025), with qualifiers on which costs are included or not stated.
